## Goal
One or two sentences: what a user/developer can do when this workstream is done.

## Design
Concrete and complete enough that a junior never guesses: file paths, exported function/type signatures, route paths, request/response JSON, component props, state shapes, commercetools resources/keys/actions used (verify against the loaded skill and the docs tools, never from memory), env vars, messages keys (both locales), tokens used, edge cases. Reference design files (`design/DESIGN.md`, `design/specs/*.md`) and decisions (D-nnn). Mark anything undrawn and add the SO-nn it needs.
